name: Hohenahr (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hohenahr (oak branches with acorns above a lion on blue and yellow).
history: The flag was approved for the municipality by the Hessian Minister of the Interior on 23 March 1988, showing the arms on a blue-yellow striped cloth.

features.role: Hohenahr arms — oak branches and lion
